title: Grade 8 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

2. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

3. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

8. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

9. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Middle Distance Races and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — The speed of the music

2. B — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Red, blue, and yellow

11. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Swimming; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Indigenous Games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Middle Distance Races and Montage; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
